market_wrap.text: Nifty fell 0.63% to 25,228 and the Sensex lost about 500 points, with metals, IT and FMCG the weakest sectors and mid caps down nearly 1%; a dollar near a 19-month high and rising bets on a US Fed rate rise in December weighed on sentiment even as crude eased. Your stocks and ETFs fell 1.5%, mostly because silver and gold slid again; today's mutual-fund NAVs were not yet published by 10:07 PM IST, so fund values still reflect 17 November.

reasons.reason: Silver fell over 3% on MCX and below $46 an ounce globally, its lowest in more than a year, while gold dropped about 2%, as the dollar hit a 19-month high and markets priced in a near-certain US Fed rate rise in December ahead of the Fed's meeting minutes. A firmer rupee pushed domestic prices down further.

Metal stocks were the worst sector today (Nifty Metal down about 2.5%) as copper hit a five-month low on a strong dollar, Fed rate-rise expectations, weak China data and doubts over AI-related demand. No company-specific news.

No company news found today. Capital-market stocks fell as a group (KFin was the biggest loser, CAMS and Nippon AMC also down about 3%) after SEBI's chairman reportedly said the regulator is reviewing margin-trading limits; this also gave back part of Tuesday's 2.9% jump.

news.headline: Promoter Indo Borax pledges its entire 64% stake
news.summary: Indo Borax pledged all 2.38 crore Kronox shares it holds as added security for a roughly ₹225 crore loan taken to buy the stake; it says ownership and control are unchanged.

events.detail: Shareholders vote on the new Chairman (Mudit Kumar Singh) and Managing Director (Deep Saraf); the e-voting cut-off date is 20 November.
Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Meeting runs 8–9 December; markets expect a rate rise, the main pressure on silver and gold lately.
events.affects: Silver and gold funds (about 30% of the portfolio)

events.detail: Companies usually report from mid-January to mid-February; results moved Manorama, Hindustan Copper and KRN this quarter.

outlook.view: Gold fell below $3,800 to a 14-month low and silver lost about 3% as markets put roughly 96% odds on a December US rate rise; the Silver Institute still projects a sixth straight annual supply deficit.
outlook.watch: US Fed decision on 9 December and the dollar.

outlook.view: They led today and have outperformed large caps this year, but they fall harder when rates rise or foreign investors sell.
outlook.watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

outlook.view: AI demand is lifting hardware makers like Netweb, but a global sell-off in AI stocks hit Indian IT today (Nifty IT −0.9%).
Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge, but copper has since slipped to a five-month low on a strong dollar and weak China data, dragging metal stocks.
outlook.watch: Global copper prices and the dollar.

outlook.view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
